newsitem.title: USA: Trump Hotel,Rank said in Castle pact.
newsitem.headline: Trump Hotel,Rank said in Castle pact.

text.p: Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc and Britain's Rank Organisation Plc are set to unveil Tuesday in New York City Rank's $50 million change of theme of Atlantic City's Trump Castle into a Hard Rock Casino Hotel, sources close to the situation said.
The agreement is expected to be long-term, likely 30 years in duration, the sources said.

Terms of the agreement between Trump and Rank remain subject to formal documentation. The terms include Rank sharing in a percentage of gaming profit above a certain level and Trump sharing in the Hard Rock restaurant and merchandising profits, also above a certain level.
